page_title: INT 1-0 JUV | Inter v Juventus 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Fabio Maresca has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
90+4' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Weston McKennie is replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus).
89' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in a cross from the corner, but Wojciech Szczesny reads it well and gathers the ball.
89' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alessandro Bastoni walks off the pitch to be replaced by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Davy Klaassen (Inter) replaces Nicolo Barella.
88' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabio Miretti (Juventus) replacing Andrea Cambiaso.
88' Federico Gatti will be replaced by Alex Sandro (Juventus).
87' Bremer (Juventus) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
87' Great save! Marko Arnautovic (Inter) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Wojciech Szczesny.
87' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
85' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Wojciech Szczesny comes off his line to gather the ball.
81' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
79' Simone Inzaghi appears to have said too much and referee Fabio Maresca comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
78' The resulting corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) comes to nothing.
77' Here is a change. Marcus Thuram is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Marko Arnautovic (Inter).

77' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Marcus Thuram (Inter). This is a yellow card! Marcus Thuram (Inter) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
76' Marcus Thuram (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
76' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:12. The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.
73' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Federico Dimarco and he is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
73' It's time for a substitution. Denzel Dumfries (Inter) comes on in place of Matteo Darmian.

72' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time low shot towards goal from a promising distance, but Yann Sommer denies him.
71' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.

70' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.

69' It's unbelievable, Nicolo Barella (Inter) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot to the bottom right corner from a few yards out, but Wojciech Szczesny reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
67' Timothy Weah has a look up and finds Federico Gatti (Juventus) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post.
66' Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
66' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a change. Federico Chiesa (Juventus) replaces Kenan Yildiz.
66' The game has come to an end for Filip Kostic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Timothy Weah (Juventus).
66' Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Federico Dimarco (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but Wojciech Szczesny punches the ball away.
64' Nicolo Barella does a good job setting up Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) on the edge of the box, but his nice effort curls just over the bar.
63' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
63' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
62' Filip Kostic (Juventus) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
61' Marcus Thuram (Inter) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Federico Dimarco.
59' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) is penalised for holding. Fabio Maresca signals a set piece. There is a free kick near the sideline to Juventus.
59' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
57' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the right post and wastes a promising chance!
56' Federico Dimarco (Inter) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
55' Danilo (Juventus) receives the ball from Manuel Locatelli and tries to beat the keeper from long range, but the effort goes high over the bar.
53' Filip Kostic (Juventus) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
51' The game is interrupted. Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
50' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) tries to find Benjamin Pavard, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
48' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) touches the ball with his hand.
46' Referee Fabio Maresca blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Weston McKennie (Juventus) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Filip Kostic (Juventus) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
42' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Federico Dimarco, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
39' Referee Fabio Maresca points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Inter players celebrate.
38' The Inter players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
37' 1 - 0 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Federico Gatti (Juventus), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:0.
36' Filip Kostic (Juventus) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

35' Filip Kostic (Juventus) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
34' Marcus Thuram (Inter) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' Danilo (Juventus) has tested the patience of referee Fabio Maresca and goes into the book for a previous late challenge. Danilo (Juventus) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
32' Filip Kostic (Juventus) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

32' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a low pass from outside the box to Dusan Vlahovic. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
29' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
28' 9:0 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:0.
25' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sprays a pass out to Marcus Thuram, but he can't beat his man inside the box.

21' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
21' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

19' The referee blows his whistle for unsporting behaviour, with Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) the culprit. Yellow card! It's like Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Fabio Maresca agrees and books him.
18' Federico Dimarco (Inter) does well to meet a cross from Benjamin Pavard, but he directs his shot just wide of the left post.
16' Nicolo Barella (Inter) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
15' A lofted cross from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
12' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
9' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a long ball forward to Nicolo Barella, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
8' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Fabio Maresca blows for a foul.
6' The corner kick from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
5' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
5' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
5' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Inter earn a corner.
2' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
1' Marcus Thuram (Inter) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Now Inter have a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca will referee today's match.
